### Links

[{{< fa brands github >}} View source code](https://github.com/openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed/tree/v0.3.0/src/single_cell/process_integrate_annotate)

[![](/images/viash-hub-logo.svg){.vh-icon} Browse all versions](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed)

[![](/images/viash-hub-logo.svg){.vh-icon} Get run instructions](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/process_integrate_annotate)

:::

::: {.ref-description}
- Harmony
- scVI
- Scanorama
- BBKNN

Available annotation methods:

- CellTypist
- Harmony integration followed by KNN label transfer (harmony_knn)
- scANVI (with scArches)
- scVI integration followed by KNN label transfer (scvi_knn)
- SingleR

When more than one annotation method is selected, a final consensus vote
combines the per-method predictions into a single consensus label.
:::

The minimum number of genes present in both the reference and query datasets.

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sanitize_ensembl_ids`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to sanitize ensembl gene ids by removing version numbers. Read by
the celltypist, scanvi_scarches, scvi_knn and singler annotation methods.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obs_categorical_covariates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs column(s) in the input query with categorical covariates to correct for
in addition to the batch label. Used by the scvi integration method and by the
scanvi_scarches annotation method. Treated as nuisance factors, so do not use
them for biological signal you want to keep. For scanvi_scarches their order
must match --reference_obs_categorical_covariates.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obs_numerical_covariates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs column(s) in the input query with continuous (numerical) covariates to
correct for in addition to the batch label. Used by the scvi integration method
and by the scanvi_scarches annotation method. Treated as nuisance factors, so do
not use them for biological signal you want to keep. For scanvi_scarches their
order must match --reference_obs_numerical_covariates.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Pre-processing options: Mitochondrial & Ribosomal Gene Detection

Pre-processing options for detecting mitochondrial genes

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_name_mitochondrial_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which .var slot to store a boolean array corresponding the mitochondrial genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_name_ribosomal_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which .var slot to store a boolean array corresponding the ribosomal genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_name_mitochondrial_fraction`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
When specified, write the fraction of counts originating from mitochondrial genes
(based on --mitochondrial_gene_regex) to an .obs column with the specified name.
Requires --var_name_mitochondrial_genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_name_ribosomal_fraction`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
When specified, write the fraction of counts originating from ribosomal genes
(based on --ribosomal_gene_regex) to an .obs column with the specified name.
Requires --var_name_ribosomal_genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--mitochondrial_gene_regex`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Regex string that identifies mitochondrial genes from --var_gene_names.
By default will detect human and mouse mitochondrial genes from a gene symbol.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"^[mM][tT]-"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--ribosomal_gene_regex`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Regex string that identifies ribosomal genes from --var_gene_names.
By default will detect human and mouse ribosomal genes from a gene symbol.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"^[Mm]?[Rr][Pp][LlSs]"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Pre-processing options: QC metrics calculation options

Pre-processing options for calculating QC metrics

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name

Description

Attributes

::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_qc_metrics`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Keys to select a boolean (containing only True or False) column from .var.
For each cell, calculate the proportion of total values for genes which are labeled 'True',
compared to the total sum of the values for all genes. Defaults to the combined values specified for
--var_name_mitochondrial_genes and --highly_variable_features_var_output.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"ercc,highly_variable"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `","`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--top_n_vars`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of top vars to be used to calculate cumulative proportions.
If not specified, proportions are not calculated.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `50`, `100`, `200`, `500`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `","`
:::
::::
:::::

Arguments related to calculating the n nearest neighbors. Only relevant for --annotation_methods `scvi_knn`, `scanvi_scarches` and `harmony_knn`.

:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}

`--knn_weights`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Weight function used in prediction. Possible values are:
`uniform` (all points in each neighborhood are weighted equally) or

:::

The number of neighbors to use in k-neighbor graph structure used for fast approximate nearest neighbor search with PyNNDescent.
Larger values will result in more accurate search results at the cost of computation time.

`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `15`

[Min]{.arg-key} `5`

:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--run_consensus`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Run a final consensus vote combining the per-method predictions. Only
takes effect when more than one --annotation_methods is selected; with a
single method there is nothing to combine and the step is skipped.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot in which to store the consensus predicted cell type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"consensus_pred"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_score`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot in which to store the consensus score, defined as the fraction
of total weight assigned to the winning cell type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"consensus_score"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_use_probabilities`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Scale each method's vote by its per-cell prediction probability. When
false, every method votes with equal weight regardless of confidence.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_tie_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Label to assign when two or more cell types receive equal votes. If not
provided, tied cells are assigned a missing value.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Unknown"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/process_integrate_annotate/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/process_integrate_annotate);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/process_integrate_annotate/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
